title: Environments, Git and deployments
objectives: Keep Dev, Test and Prod as separate workspaces
Work out what a deployment would change before it runs
Know why Prod changes only through Git and a deployment

exercises.prompt: dev_items and prod_items list each item and its version. Return what deploying Dev to Prod would change: item, and change as 'add' (only in Dev) or 'update' (a different version), in item order. Items only in Prod are left alone.
hints: The starter finds new items only. An item in both with a different version changes too.
LEFT JOIN prod_items on item: no match is 'add'; a match with a different version is 'update'.
